test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In May 2025, IBM and TCS partnered with Andhra Pradesh to build the “Quantum Valley Tech Park” in __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amaravati**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The "Quantum Valley Tech Park" initiative was announced in partnership with IBM and TCS to boost quantum computing research and technological innovation in India.
 
• The park will be established in Amaravati, the capital city of Andhra Pradesh, known for its development focus and infrastructure projects.
 
• Quantum computing is a transformative technology that utilizes quantum mechanics to solve complex computational problems faster than classical computers.
 
• This collaboration aims to position India as a global hub for quantum computing and advanced technologies, attracting talent and investments in the field.
 
• The establishment of this tech park aligns with India's vision of fostering innovation and advancing technological frontiers in areas like artificial intelligence, cryptography, and data analytics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Quantum Computing Basics:**

 
 
• Quantum computing relies on quantum bits or qubits, which can represent both 0 and 1 simultaneously due to superposition.
 
• Entanglement is another key property, enabling qubits to be interconnected and share information instantaneously.
 
• Quantum computing applications include cryptography, optimization problems, drug development, and AI advancements.
 
 
 
• **Amaravati as a Technological Hub:**
 
 
• Amaravati is being developed as a smart city with an emphasis on sustainability and technology-driven infrastructure.
 
• It is positioned to attract investments in IT, biotechnology, and advanced research domains.
 
 
 
• **IBM's Role in Quantum Research:**
 
 
• IBM has been a global leader in quantum computing, offering platforms like IBM Quantum Experience for research and development.
 
• It collaborates with academia and industries to advance quantum technologies and train skilled professionals.
 
 
 
• **TCS Contribution to Technology:**
 
 
• TCS is one of India's leading IT services companies, known for its innovation in emerging technologies.
 
• The partnership with Andhra Pradesh reflects TCS's commitment to fostering technological growth and capability building in India.
